entries.description: Read guiding-principles.md and lessons-learned.md pre-session; confirmed user direction to start security-dashboard-polish Session 1 despite UAT folder still showing in-progress (it is a single-session UAT-prep spec whose change-log.md was never generated; human UAT results already in the checklist JSON).

PageAuthorizationHandler.HandleRequirementAsync now calls context.Fail() with an AuthorizationFailureReason on every denial path (unregistered-fail-closed, explicit Deny, no-allowed-role, scoped-admin missing session context or organization match). Succeeds paths unchanged.

Replaced app.UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute("/not-found") with a custom app.UseStatusCodePages handler that only re-executes /not-found for genuine 404 responses. 401/403 are no longer swallowed and can now surface the Blazor <NotAuthorized> fragment.

Created Components/Shared/AccessDeniedCard.razor (centered MudCard with lock icon, approved copy "You dont have access to this page. If you need access, please request it from your administrator.", role=alert, aria-live=assertive, Back to dashboard button navigating to /dashboard). Wired Routes.razor <NotAuthorized> to render <AccessDeniedCard />. Updated /access-denied page (AccessDenied.razor) to render the same card while preserving its existing data-testid="access-denied-page" wrapper so existing Playwright/WebGuardrail tests that depend on the redirect path keep passing.

Added AccessDenied_BackofficeUser_SecurityDashboard_ShowsCenteredCardAndAvoidsNotFoundAsync Playwright test. Signs in as BackofficeUser jdoe@acmecoffee.com, navigates to /admin/security, asserts URL does not contain /not-found, and asserts access-denied-card, approved copy, and access-denied-back-button are visible.

Added AccessDeniedCardTests bUnit suite (4 tests): approved copy is rendered, Back-to-dashboard button is rendered, clicking the button calls NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/dashboard"), and wrapper has role=alert + aria-live=assertive.

Moved deny-allow-header.svg from project root to src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/wwwroot/ so it is served as a Razor-class-library static web asset at _content/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/deny-allow-header.svg. No csproj changes needed — wwwroot is auto-wired by Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Razor.

Added PermissionState enum (Unset=0, Allow=1, Deny=2) in src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Configuration/PermissionState.cs. Mutual exclusion is now a property of the data model itself — a cell is exactly one of the three values.

Created shared DenyAllowSwitch.razor in src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Components/Admin/ wrapping MudToggleGroup<PermissionState> with single-selection mode, three items (Deny / — / Allow), and role-aware color (Error for Deny, Success for Allow, Default for Unset). Exposes Value, ValueChanged, and AriaLabel parameters. Sessions 3 and 4 will reuse it. Chose MudToggleGroup over MudSwitch<bool?> because the three-state decision is fundamentally ternary and toggle-group enforces mutual exclusion visually and structurally.

Refactored DabblerPagePermissionMatrix.razor: replaced the two MudCheckBox columns (Allow / Deny) with a single column hosting a DenyAllowSwitch per cell. Internal state moved from separate _allowed/_denied HashSet<string> dictionaries to a single nested Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, PermissionState>>. Save-time projection produces the same PagePermission.AllowedRoles / DeniedRoles shape, so persistence format and handler behavior are unchanged. Legend caption updated to describe the three states.

Widened matrix cards ~33%: card style changed from min-width:260px/flex:1 1 260px/max-width:480px to min-width:340px/flex:1 1 340px/max-width:600px. Single permission column uses width:1%; white-space:nowrap; text-align:center so the switch sits centered and the Role column takes the remaining space — removes horizontal scroll at normal desktop widths. Table now has width:100%.

Updated DabblerPagePermissionMatrixTests.cs: replaced the checkbox-based 'ExistingAllowedPermissions_CheckedOnRender' test with 'ExistingAllowedPermissions_RenderSwitchInAllowState' (asserts DenyAllowSwitch.Value is PermissionState.Allow). Added 'ExistingDeniedPermissions_RenderSwitchInDenyState', 'RendersDenyAllowHeaderSvg_NotSeparateAllowAndDenyColumns', 'FlipAllowToDeny_DropsAllow_AndAddsDeny_OnSave' (the Allow→Deny mutual-exclusion invariant called out in the spec), 'FlipDenyToAllow_DropsDeny_AndAddsAllow_OnSave', and 'SetToUnset_OmitsRoleFromBothLists_OnSave'. The invariant test is whitebox-executed through the shared DenyAllowSwitch's ValueChanged callback, which is the exact path MudToggleGroup invokes on user selection.

Added PermissionResolver.cs in src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Authorization/. Exposes ResolveRoleChain(roleName, hasValue, allRoles) that walks the RoleDefinition.InheritsFrom chain starting at roleName and returns RoleChainResolution(Found, InheritedFromRole). InheritedFromRole is null when the entry is on the role itself (explicit). Cycle detection via a visited HashSet prevents infinite loops on malformed inheritance graphs. Accepts a predicate rather than a typed dictionary so Page, Endpoint, and Entity matrices can all share it (boolean entry presence for Page/Endpoint, set-contains-op for Entity).

Added InheritedLegend.razor (MudAlert, Severity.Normal, Outlined, Dense, Info icon, data-testid='inherited-legend') with inline message: 'Solid = explicit · italic/dim = inherited'. The sample text 'italic/dim = inherited' is wrapped in a span.inherited-sample so the legend visibly demonstrates the convention using the same italic+opacity styling that inherited cells use.

Updated DabblerPagePermissionMatrix.razor, DabblerEndpointPermissionMatrix.razor, and DabblerEntityPermissionMatrix.razor: each cell now calls ResolveCell(...) which dispatches to PermissionResolver.ResolveRoleChain to discover whether the effective value is explicit on the role or inherited from an ancestor. Inherited cells wrap the DenyAllowSwitch / MudCheckBox in <MudTooltip Text='inherited from <parent>'> and apply css class 'permission-cell inherited' (font-style:italic; opacity:0.6). Explicit cells skip the tooltip and use the plain 'permission-cell' class. Each matrix renders <InheritedLegend /> above the filter textbox. The SaveAsync path still persists only the role's own explicit entries — inherited values are visualized but not duplicated into the role's explicit list on save.

Added tests: Dabbler.Security.Tests/Authorization/PermissionResolverTests.cs (7 tests: explicit-on-role, inherited-from-direct-parent, inherited-from-grandparent, explicit-wins-over-ancestor, not-found, isolated-role-no-chain, cyclic-inheritance-does-not-loop). Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests DabblerPagePermissionMatrixTests added 'InheritedCell_RendersInheritedClass_AndTooltipNamesParentRole', 'ExplicitCell_OverridesParent_DoesNotRenderInheritedStyle', 'InheritedLegend_IsRendered_WhenRolesAndPagesExist'. DabblerEndpointPermissionMatrixTests added 'InheritedCell_RendersInheritedClass_AndTooltipNamesParentRole' and 'InheritedLegend_IsRendered_WhenRolesAndEndpointsExist'. DabblerEntityPermissionMatrixTests added 'InheritedOpCell_RendersInheritedClass_AndTooltipNamesParentRole' and 'InheritedLegend_IsRendered_WhenRolesAndEntitiesExist'. Tests assert 'div.permission-cell.inherited' presence and MudTooltip.Text equals 'inherited from <parent>'.
